ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note the conflicting "I'm Here" records (F6 vs F7) and remind the driver that the fee may only be imposed when the arrival tap is genuinely recorded — no account flag on this record.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement that he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited >3 min conflicts with the system timeline record F7 (driver_pressed_here_at = null); statements do not override system records, and NS-1 (i) is therefore not established, so the $6.61 fee cannot stand.
Chat assertion 'Waited more than 3 min, cancelling' asserts the wait condition but not the mandatory arrival-tap condition (NS-1 (i)); the wait alone does not make the cancellation fee valid.
